style_suffix: Modern high-end console fantasy game screenshot look, stylized realism, rich detail, soft volumetric light and atmospheric haze. Wide view, no people, no text, no UI.

areas.KokiriForest_Child: A hidden forest village enclosed by a ring of giant ancient trees. Small cozy houses built inside hollow tree stumps, with round wooden doors, little windows, ladders and rope railings; a raised wooden walkway on stilts; a soft grassy clearing with a small stream and a tiny wooden bridge; golden sunbeams falling through the dense canopy, floating glowing pollen motes in the air.
areas.InsideTheDekuTree: Interior of a colossal hollow ancient tree: a vast round wooden chamber with spiraling ledges of roots and vine ladders climbing the curved bark walls, a large spider web stretched over a hole in the floor at the center, glowing fungus lanterns, shafts of soft green light from far above.
areas.LostWood_Child: A maze-like misty forest of tall dark trees, several hollow log tunnels leading off in different directions from a small clearing, a tree stump like a little stage, mossy ground, drifting fog, glowing blue fireflies, mysterious and playful mood.
areas.SacredForestMeadow_Child: A secluded hedge maze deep in the forest opening onto a sunlit grassy meadow, old stone steps rising to a small ancient stone pedestal, an overgrown ruined stone stairway and archway at the back among the trees, wildflowers, sunbeams.
areas.HyruleField_Child: A vast rolling green grassland plain under a bright blue sky, a winding dirt road, scattered lone trees, a distant volcano with a ring of cloud around its summit on the horizon, a walled castle town far away, and a large blue lake glimpsed in the distance.
areas.Market_Child: An empty medieval fantasy town square early in the morning before anyone is awake: a central stone fountain, colorful stone houses with banners, closed market stalls with awnings, a cobblestone plaza, a stately white stone temple with a tall spire beyond the roofs, warm soft light. The square is completely deserted.
